description.value:
Duration constant

You may use Feral Surge one additional time per day. When you would roll on the Frenzy Table, reduce the result by 1, to a minimum of 1.

cinderfall.incomplete: Both clauses key off homebrew resources/tables with no Foundry-schema representation anywhere in the corpus. Feral Surge (uses/day) and the Frenzy Table (a GM-rolled random-mishap table) are absent from the corpus's Foundry schema; no rule element hooks a table-roll result to modify or reroll it.
